ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 70% high-intensity white interior pixels vs 30% low-intensity black perimeter pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central region covering the interior of both lobes; thick black contiguous banding along the entire trailing edge and outer margins; small black stippling/mottling at the insertion point of the peduncle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an estimated interior angle of 42 degrees and a depth reaching approximately 25% of the fluke's vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the trailing edge; irregular peaks and valleys with a pixel-amplitude of approximately 4-8 pixels, particularly concentrated on the medial trailing edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex outer margins tapering into sharp, upwardly curved tips (flukes).

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized white circular clusters visible on the black distal margin of the left lobe and smaller clusters near the center-bottom of the fluke.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, near-parallel vertical dark linear streaks (rake marks) on the high-intensity white surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant calcareous barnacle colonization and rough-textured scarring at the distal tip of the left fluke lobe; additional scarring at the fluke base.
other_distinctive_markers: Portion of a secondary appendage (pectoral fin) visible on the far left of the frame exhibiting high-density scarring and barnacle attachment.
